text:
alex: Morning thread to capture postmortem follow-ups from last night's multi-region control-plane flakiness + model-registry 401 storm. Need owners and short timelines so we can close items. I'll create a ticket after this.
srini: I'll take the model-registry auth fallout. Root cause: token refresher crashed during KMS key rotation. Short-term: cached-token fallback + alerting on refresh failures. ETA 3 business days. Preventative control: pre-rotation canary.
zoe: I'll own routing fallback for control-plane errors and a temporary region-preference policy. Short-term ETA: 4 business days for policy + canary. Long-term: SLA negotiation with cloud provider.
ops-bot: Created tracker EDRW-213: https://redwood.internal/incidents/EDRW-213. Owners add checklist items.
srini: Prometheus alert I'll add:
alert: ModelRegistryTokenRefreshFailures
expr: increase(model_registry_token_refresh_failures[15m]) > 0
for: 5m
labels: severity=high

zoe: Routing policy example I'll refine in PR: {"route":"generation","fallback":["gcp-us-west1","aws-us-east-1"],"circuit_breaker":{"threshold":0.05}}
alex: Ops asks before we close: 1) add one preventative control line per checklist item, 2) label related alerts with external_dep=true so regression detection can pick them up.
srini: Claimed model-registry item, starting branch now. Will post PR link to EDRW-213.
zoe: Canaried routing change plan: 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 24h if green. Added rollout note to ticket.
ops-bot: EDRW-213 updated with checklist and statuses. Next review in weekly ops sync.
alex: Thanks all. Closing this thread ":thumbsup:"
